the development of a computer program for designing magnets with exquisite field uniformity and minimized fringe field.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown how to design high-homogeneity NMR or MRI magnets with minimal fringe field.
a magnet with a 12th order field profile and 21st order annulled fringe field has a 30-cmdiameter spherical region of 0.1 ppm field homogeneity and an OSHA hazard zone of 0.5%.

a computer program, given the specifications for a magnet (field strength, bore size, etc.) and the homogeneity and fringe field requirements, can design a magnet with the desired performance.
